values.name: Carrier loads
values.description: The cargo is loaded in the equipment by the carrier.

values.name: Full loads
values.description: Container to be stuffed or stripped under responsibility and for account of the shipper or the consignee.

values.name: Less than full loads
values.description: Container to be stuffed and stripped for account and risk of the carrier.

values.name: Shipper loads
values.description: The cargo is loaded in the equipment by the shipper.

values.name: To be delivered
values.description: The cargo is to be delivered as instructed.

values.name: To be kept
values.description: The cargo is to be retained awaiting further instructions.

values.name: Transhipment not allowed
values.description: Transhipment of goods is not allowed.

values.name: Partial shipment and/or drawing allowed
values.description: Partial shipment and/or drawing is allowed.

values.name: Partial shipment and/or drawing not allowed
values.description: Partial shipment and/or drawing is not allowed.

values.name: Carrier unloads
values.description: The cargo is to be unloaded from the equipment by the carrier.

values.name: Shipper unloads
values.description: The cargo is to be unloaded from the equipment by the shipper.

values.name: Consignee unloads
values.description: The cargo is to be unloaded from the equipment by the consignee.

values.name: Consignee loads
values.description: The cargo is to be loaded in the equipment by the consignee.

values.name: Exclusive usage of equipment
values.description: Usage of the equipment is reserved for exclusive use.

values.name: Non exclusive usage of equipment
values.description: Usage of the equipment is not reserved for exclusive use.
